verdict.rationale: PostHog documents several ways to set up automations that run unattended. Workflows offer triggers, delays, splits and PostHog actions, and CDP destinations and batch exports run in realtime or on a schedule. The Self-driving loop has scouts that emit signals, an agent that investigates reports and opens PRs, and a check on whether each change worked. Replay Vision scanners watch recordings automatically, and Desktop cloud agents keep working after the app is closed. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that these background automations run reliably (all evidence is first-party, and the 90-scout dogfooding claim is vendor-reported).
